exposure: Heart disease classified by WHO guidelines (WHO II, III, IV)
cohort: The study included 345 pregnant women with heart disease who underwent procedures in an obstetric center at a referral hospital in Sao Paulo.
finding: The incidence of severe maternal morbidity was 2.86 per 1000 live births and was significantly associated with WHO classifications III and IV of heart disease.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at admission/delivery was 37 weeks.
